purpose: Document first-party local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: A city-local real-property registry is confirmed, but reviewed public map evidence is general mapping and does not expose a verified anonymous parcel-geometry schema. No property, owner, address, plot, khatian or title lookup was submitted. No full parcel geometry was retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Pingdingshan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau current section “不动产登记” (real-property registration) publishes 2026 service guidance and registration-center notices.

2026 municipal registration guide identifies Pingdingshan Real Estate Registration Center, municipal service-center reception and online applications; applicant materials and review are part of registering rights.
City basic-survey plan documents Tianditu Pingdingshan public map-service maintenance and 1:1000 topographic mapping; it does not identify public cadastral parcel vectors.
Municipal Natural Resources Comprehensive Support Center issued a 2025 notice giving city real-estate registration service contacts, confirming an active local registry channel.

attempts.result: Registration notices and 2026 procedures present; no public polygon service.
Describes Tianditu Pingdingshan and city topographic products; parcel-vector access not documented.
